[[CS Sfaxien]] | continentalcup3 = [[Arab Champions League]] | continentalcup3 qualifiers = | league topscorer = [[Michael Eneramo]] (18 goals) | biggest home win = [[Etoile du Sahel|ESS]] 7–0 [[CS Hammam-Lif|CSHL]] | biggest away win = [[CA Bizertin|CAB]] 0–5 [[Etoile du Sahel|ESS]] | highest scoring = [[Etoile du Sahel|ESS]] 7–0 [[CS Hammam-Lif|CSHL]] | matches = 182 | total goals = 359 | prevseason = [[2007–08 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2007–08]] | nextseason = [[2009–10 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1|2009–10]] }} The '''2008–09 [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1]]''' was the 54th season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Tunisia]]. It began on 8 August 2008 and concluded on 13 May 2009. The competition saw the return of two previous participants, [[AS Kasserine|Avenir Sportif de Kasserine]] and [[ES Hammam-Sousse|Espoir Sportif de Hammam-Sousse]] from [[Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 2|Ligue Professionnelle 2]].
